scope: Fictional omnichannel pilot. Inputs support candidate decisions, not real personnel, implementation or benefits.

role_inputs.scope: 输入充分的虚构全渠道实验：已声明政策、行为及同期工作量

mandate.scope: 全渠道订单履约改造的候选架构分析
mandate.decision_owner: 虚构经营责任人；仅用于实验的责任声明

tasks.decision: 依据声明的一致性与延迟目标比较线上同步及异步最终确认；离线仅受理待确认
tasks.outcome: 线上同步试点建议、离线待确认契约及异常验证清单

behavioral_criteria: 独立完成异常接口设计并经评审
requirements.tailoring_reason: 同步/异步候选比较需要接口、失败和恢复细节支持有效决策，本次采用3级；困难条件仍需可验证专家支持，不等于任何情况下独立。
requirements.adoption_context: 虚构教学场景已采用的目标；不是实际组织批准，也不是自动执行权限

behavioral_evidence.criterion: 独立完成异常接口设计并经评审

assessments.note: 本任务行为已在虚构材料中给定；困难情形仍需专家，不表示通用认证。

assignments.authority: 虚构候选配置；真实批准未授予

factor.description: Recovery backlog 1000 events; measured fixture processing 500 events/hour; recovery window 4 hours.

gap.description: Local store keys cannot identify duplicate orders across channels.
gap.dependency_basis: Data governance must define event_id policy before cross-channel idempotency outcomes can be compared.

work_packages.name: Shared event key pilot
work_packages.scope: Two stores use event_id and reconcile duplicate orders

work_packages.name: Event key policy and data governance
work_packages.scope: Define uniqueness, originating store and retention

increment.description: Two stores use central event_id for online orders and isolate duplicates. Offline acceptance is excluded.
increment.acceptance: Ten duplicate deliveries in 1000 synthetic events must be isolated; verify order keys and audit records. Actual test results remain absent.

transition.name: Two-store online pilot
transition.scope: Two stores, online orders only; central inventory confirmation remains mandatory.

value_risk.authority: Simulated planning committee exercise rules; no actual approval

criteria.meaning: Speed within pilot window; 1 slowest, 5 fastest

missing.assignment: Available hours absent; capacity remains unresolved.
missing.factor: Drain rate absent; meeting the recovery window is unknown.
missing.gap: Dependency assessment absent; null must not become an empty list.
missing.increment: Increment description absent; a link alone is insufficient.
missing.transition: Service taxonomy absent; do not infer it from layout.
missing.value_risk: V-SPEED weight absent; no equal weighting or zero substitution.

change.assignment: Task workload grows from 32 to 48 hours; availability stays 40 hours.
change.factor: Backlog grows to 3000; rate stays 500. Recovery window still 4 hours.
change.gap: Add security audit WP-AUDIT dependency while retaining WP-POLICY.
change.increment: Add WP-OFFLINE to TRANS-OFFLINE; persist offline requests, confirm centrally later.
change.transition: Expand from two to four stores; state expanded-pilot, capacity validation pending.
change.value_risk: WP-KEY V-COVERAGE changes from 5 to 3; all prior weights and other scores stay fixed.
